# fjordrun_vpc (Resource)

A private network: environments of several projects of a team whose services reach each other privately. Add environments with `fjordrun_vpc_member`. Hobby plan or higher (2 networks on Hobby, 10 on Pro). Needs the admin role, and a token with access to the whole team.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "team_id" {
  type = string
}

resource "fjordrun_vpc" "backend" {
  team_id     = var.team_id
  name        = "backend"
  description = "Internal APIs and their databases"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name (1-60 characters, unique in the team).
- `team_id` (String) Team ID.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free text (up to 2000 characters).

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time.
- `id` (String) Private network ID.
- `slug` (String) URL-safe name.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# team_id/vpc_id
terraform import fjordrun_vpc.backend 11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111/bbbbbbbb-bbbb-bbbb-bbbb-bbbbbbbbbbbb
```
